aboutText: Old World Restoration and Picket Fences has been serving Newport for over 20 years, specialising in fence restoration and picket fence installations. We offer comprehensive Fence Kits for the DIY handyman, complete with easy-to-follow instructions. Our team is always available to assist with product selection and project planning, ensuring you get the perfect fence for your property.
servicesText: From full fence restoration to custom picket fence designs, we handle all aspects of fencing in Newport. Our Fence Kits provide everything for DIY projects, backed by expert guidance from our experienced staff.
